text: {"summary":"Golden XI is in decent shape for GW12, and the deadline is Friday, so you have a few days. Haaland is the headline: Man City have a double gameweek, and Onze predicts 10.4 pts for him. One free transfer is worth using, and the rest of the squad mostly holds up.","transfers":"Transfer Henderson (£4.9m) for Gomez (£5.1m). Henderson has had poor form and Onze predicts 1.8 pts for him, while Gomez is nailed on with a medium goal threat and Onze predicts 4 pts. That is about 2 more points this week, and it uses your free transfer, so there is no hit. It also leaves £0.1m in the bank. The other suggestion, Schade to McGinn, is not worth making. Schade has a double gameweek and Onze predicts 6.8 pts for him, about 3 more than McGinn. Keep him.","captaincy":"Captain Haaland. Onze predicts 10.4 pts, the highest in your team, and he is nailed on with a high goal threat across two Man City fixtures. Schade is the vice-captain at 6.8 pts.","chips":"Triple captain is worth considering now. Man City also blank in GW14, so that week will need attention later.","priceAlerts":"Raya is at risk of falling in price. He is a doubt, and 115,297 managers have sold him this gameweek. None of this changes your transfer, but if you plan to bring in Evanilson-type players later, they are getting pricier.","formation":"Play a 3-5-2. Starting XI: Leno in goal.
